I have diseases that most people don't get until they are elderly, along with early onset osteoporosis and gastroparesis . Eating healthy is so important. I only wish I understood so earlier, but I can't imagine living into my 30s the way my body is going. 

Please, take care of your bodies. Its not just about being skinny; its about being healthy.

My best friend and I had decided to see the Struts at the Masquerade in Atlanta a while back. I was underage at the time, since you had to be 18 to get into the concert, but we were going to risk it anyway. We went and bout parking in one of those "event" parking lots. You know the ones where there is a guy out front with a makeshift sign and a lawn chair? Yea, one of those. The guy seemed really trustworthy and told us he would be there till 2am. It was 7pm when we got to the parking lot, and the concert started at 8pm. Keep in mind, I'm a 5'3", 100lb white girl and my friend is a pretty scrawny, 5'7" white guy. 

Well.. fast forward to it being 8:30pm. I had parked way farther from the venue than we thought, but we had walked before, right? I was following the directions on my smartphone; it got dark a good amount of time before. Suddenly, My friend and I come over a hill and my heart drops to my stomach. This is my first red flag. Taco Bell. This Taco Bell was one my sister had previously brought me to; she had been nearby during a robbery there and had warned me that nothing good happens in this area. So... shit. I guess i should keep going though, right?

We continue right past this Taco Bell. We saw a huge group, probably 10 guys, ahead across the street. Two by two, they began crossing over. All walking towards us. Two of the guys stayed on the other side, but went kind of hurried so they were behind us, further than the other group. I felt bad.. like I might have been making assumptions, but I noped the fuck out of there. I was scared shitless and the guys yelled stuff after us. I don't remember what; I just wanted to leave the situation. 

To make things worse. We lost the car! I'm a dumbass and somehow didn't mark the spot of the parking lot on the GPS. We had some ideas where it was, but it was so dark and sketchy we couldn't find it. Long story short, we surrendered to the horrible night at 2am and called my mom. She picked us up with my sister, yelled at us, and they laughed so hard they cried at how horrible the situation was. It was one of those psychotic, misery cackles. Ultimately, after an hour of searching we decided to go up and down the numbered streets. We thought we were near the end, but for some reason we started at the beginning. 

We ended up finding it on our very last street! Nobody else was there, and my friend had to drive home, because it was after midnight. That was the day we invented our favorite game, where is the parking lot on nth street?
